compiler.primary_outcome: paired mean native total latency; positive A-minus-B favors v2.1
limitations: Six pairs on one phone and one session limit precision and external validity.
Pairs, not individual frames, are the inferential replication units.
Bootstrap interval is exploratory and not a guarantee; exact two-sided sign-flip resolution is 2/64.
Pooled percentiles, hardware counters and stage differences are exploratory secondary metrics without multiplicity correction.
Native fixed synthetic inputs omit recurrent app staging, transport and direct vehicle USB.
Reported hardware time is a vendor aggregate and has a different measurement scope than invocation wall time.
Thermal status zero does not establish identical frequencies or power state.
Two adjacent diagnostic pairs cannot establish a precise causal instrumentation overhead.
No timer-floor subtraction; five extra clock reads per measured buffer copy.
Aggregation happens after timed unlock and remains in the whole-frame time.
Lock times may include lower-level cache or synchronization work; labels are API boundaries.
Measured memcpy time is only an upper bound for removing copies through direct preparation.
All original model input writes, output reads, locks, unlocks and finiteness checks are retained.
Fixed inputs exclude recurrent app staging and changing camera frames.
